workbench_first_attempt.page_title: 客服队列超时率复核报告 — Weave Workbench
workbench_first_attempt.team_discovery: 9 candidates returned, including Support Queue Heldout 20260910 with a dispatchable default workflow

identity_resolution_assessment.finding: Workbench discovered the active team, accepted the visible display name, and the resulting TeamRun was bound to the stable team ID without an operator-supplied UUID.

activity.failure_reason: the runtime provider credential is missing; configure runtime authentication before retrying

runtime.name: Mac Local Runtime
runtime.finding: The team builder bound every member to the provider-auth Codex engine on this runtime. The runtime advertised that engine as healthy, but the provider credential required by execution was absent.

root_cause.primary_finding: The published team selected runtime 41233bee-ebb7-4496-8923-74278a00945c with engine=codex and auth_mode=provider, but neither the run request nor the runtime process supplied the provider credential required by Codex execution.
root_cause.product_boundary_defect: Runtime catalog health and team construction admitted an engine/runtime pairing whose required provider authentication was unavailable. The first real member call, rather than readiness or publication, exposed the missing credential.
root_cause.contract_mechanism_assessment: The TeamRun inherited workflow version 1 and contract digest a74e674e..., so name resolution and published-contract admission passed. No output existed to exercise artifact checks.

proves: the repaired Workbench can discover and dispatch a visible active team name without an operator-supplied UUID
the resulting TeamRun inherits the published workflow version and delivery contract
the current runtime readiness surface can report healthy while a selected provider-auth engine lacks its required credential
the Workbench does not promote failed execution, missing delivery, or absent user assessment to business success
does_not_prove: that any team member can complete with a correctly authenticated runtime
that the output-schema verifier passes for the required report
that the arithmetic report was generated or adopted by the user
that the overall Weave business loop is complete
